propositions: Provider-prefixed model_ref strings (e.g., 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError because genai-prices expects bare model ids.
LookupError is silently caught and converted to 'unpriced' with no warning, causing usage rows to drop from cost totals.
The failure is asymmetric across providers: Bedrock-prefixed models resolve but Anthropic and OpenAI do not, biasing provider cost comparisons.
Model id translation must use registry membership to determine the provider, not prefix matching or string splitting, because Bedrock and versioned AWS ids have non-standard formats.
Genuinely unknown models should remain tolerated as unpriced without breaking summarize, but must be visibly distinguished from mis-formatted ids in output.
